main_measure.name: OLS slope of 5-bar excess return (vs coin's mean 5-bar return) on forecast, grid bars with forecast > 0
main_measure.threshold: confirm: slope > 0 with t >= 2; reject: slope < 0 with t <= -2; else inconclusive

decided_by: Confirm rule met: the slope is positive with t >= 2.
reading: The coin's mean 5-bar return is the mean over the same non-overlapping 5-bar grid of all its windows; the slope's t uses an OLS with intercept and standard errors clustered by UTC day of the signal bar (CR1 small-sample correction); the plan's 'fewer than 100 cases or 30 days' rule is applied as the minimum counts (status 'not observable').

direction_check.why: main measure +0.002415 on the check folds against +0.001747 on every fold
